requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles capable of delivering 6,000 pages for black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with CMY bottle size exceeding 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase consumable yield and reduce user intervention, supporting high-volume printing and competitive positioning against rivals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with existing and new ink platform (Magi/Nessie) and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles must be validated to deliver 6,000 pages (black/CMY) and CMY bottle must support >8,000 pages in test environments.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new bottles and filling mechanism provide spill-free reliability during user refill operations.
requirements.Rationale: Minimize mess and improve end-user experience, reducing warranty and support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with bottle design and tank interface, IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User testing demonstrates <1% spill rate during 100 consecutive refills in controlled conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a new NOA-F (Non-Original Accessory - Fill) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label. No changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhance security, reliability, and product differentiation while maintaining compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on NOA-F design and integration with bottle and tank.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes reliability and security tests; click-on push-push and TDF unchanged.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Continue using SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation to ensure supply chain and cost efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time, leverages proven technology, and ensures supply chain continuity.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compatibility with new bottle and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; print quality and reliability meet existing standards.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability and Reliability Modelling
requirements.Description: Model and validate ink stability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) performance, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reliability throughout product life cycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized ink, bottle, and IDS design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All parameters modeled and validated to meet PQ (Print Quality) and reliability standards over expected life.

requirements.Title: Support for Services/Contractual and NOA-F as Service Parts
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty and contract support scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures serviceability and support for in-warranty devices, reducing downtime and improving customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design and supply chain integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F listed as service part and available in service logistics system.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature on the bottle or tank lid for enhanced tracking or authentication.
requirements.Rationale: Improves traceability and potentially supports anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires Acumen 6 technology integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present and functional on all production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart Integration
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F production; add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool to Orcus 5; provide molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Supports manufacturing scalability and new product introduction with minimal investment.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized NOA-F and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified, validated, and ready for mass production.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the product to allow end-users to replace PHA and NOA-F components without service intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves customer experience and reduces service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product and component design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F using only instructions, with no tools required.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Design product to support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product value and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on reliability modeling and component durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes accelerated life testing to 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 PaaS (Hi + Hi PDL)
requirements.Description: Offer a second SKU with high capacity and high PDL (Page Description Language) as a Platform as a Service (PaaS) option.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses diverse customer segments and business models.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on SKU definition and platform capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available in product catalog and PaaS offering.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington industrial design (ID) with a larger tank size to support higher ink capacity; no changes to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield and aligns with new product identity.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on industrial design and tank engineering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product prototype matches Reddington ID with increased tank size, passes ID review.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Implement EPS foam packaging for improved shipping and handling protection.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage in transit and supports sustainability goals (if recyclable).
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on packaging supplier and design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests per HP standards.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for environmental and energy efficiency (for PDL SKU).
requirements.Rationale: Enables sales in regulated markets and supports HP sustainability commitments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compliance testing and certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall product size.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains usability and aesthetics with new tank size.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and tray design integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit with tank, pass usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) for improved user interface and interaction.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience and supports advanced features.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on display sourcing and UI development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display present, passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the ink delivery system (4 tubes).
requirements.Rationale: Supports new tank and bottle design, improves reliability and flow.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tube and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing validated for reliability and flow in prototype units.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Modify service station to manage aerosol emissions with changes to spit platform due to new tank.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and safety requirements, improves reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system passes emissions and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to accommodate new tube routing and increased weights from larger tank.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures printhead reliability and print quality with new configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized tank and tube design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage model validated and passes reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Enhancement for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Enhance paper path design to support increased page life (80,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces jams and wear, supporting new warranty page life goal.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on paper path redesign and component selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes reliability testing for 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Designate ink maintenance part as serviceable at service centers after 80,000-page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product life and serviceability, reducing total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on maintenance part design and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance part replacement procedure available and validated at service centers.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection for the Ink Delivery System, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Line of Identity) with one SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, reduces mis-installation, and supports increased tank size.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New IDS passes installation and reliability tests; SHAID present.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and operation with new ink system.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS and firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management pass reliability and performance tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with the new page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product performance meets customer and business expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion metrics validated in product testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi Module, and Dune FW
requirements.Description: Leverage existing electronics and firmware components to reduce development time and cost.
requirements.Rationale: Speeds time to market and leverages proven, reliable components.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on compatibility with new platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product security and compliance with HP standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass HP security compliance testing.

requirements.Title: High Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Product must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), with PDL throughput of 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses market demand for high-speed printing and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on print engine and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product validated to achieve specified print speeds in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution and Manageability
requirements.Description: Provide SMB (Small and Medium Business) manageability features and solutions, including scan and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of business customers and differentiates from competitors.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Product Management, IT Admins
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on firmware and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB manageability features available and functional in release firmware.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support for WorkFromHome/Flexworker
requirements.Description: Enable Platform as a Service (PaaS) support for WorkFromHome and Flexworker use cases.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses changing work patterns and increases product relevance.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on PaaS platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: WorkFromHome/Flexworker support available in PaaS offerings.

requirements.Title: Onboarding Paths for Multiple Segments
requirements.Description: Provide onboarding and S&O (Setup & Onboarding) paths for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP segments.
requirements.Rationale: Improves customer experience and broadens market reach.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, IT Admins
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on onboarding workflow and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All onboarding paths available and validated in product launch.

requirements.Title: Multi-Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for maximum compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility with customer environments and IT infrastructures.
requirements.Stakeholders: IT Admins, End Users, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on driver development and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers available and validated at launch.

requirements.Title: Strategic Segmentation and Competitive Positioning
requirements.Description: Protect Micro/SMB segments, lead with LaserJet, flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise, and target CISS growth against competitors (e.g., Epson).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures HP retains and grows market share in key segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product positioning and marketing strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Segment strategies reflected in go-to-market and product launch plans.
